complete.en: And complete the Hajj and 'umrah for Allah.

provision.en: And take provisions, but indeed, the best provision is fear of Allah.

proclaim.ar: وَأَذِّنْ فِي النَّاسِ بِالْحَجِّ يَأْتُوكَ رِجَالًا وَعَلَىٰ كُلِّ ضَامِرٍ يَأْتِينَ مِنْ كُلِّ فَجٍّ عَمِيقٍ
proclaim.en: And proclaim to the people the Hajj [pilgrimage]; they will come to you on foot and on every lean camel; they will come from every distant pass.

ancient.en: And [let them] perform Tawaf around the ancient House.

safa.ar: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ
safa.en: Indeed, as-Safa and al-Marwah are among the symbols of Allah.

mashar.ar: فَإِذَا أَفَضْتُمْ مِنْ عَرَفَاتٍ فَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ عِنْدَ الْمَشْعَرِ الْحَرَامِ
mashar.en: But when you depart from 'Arafat, remember Allah at al-Mash'ar al-Haram.

days.en: And remember Allah during [specific] numbered days.

meat.ar: لَنْ يَنَالَ اللَّهَ لُحُومُهَا وَلَا دِمَاؤُهَا وَلَٰكِنْ يَنَالُهُ التَّقْوَىٰ مِنْكُمْ
meat.en: Their meat will not reach Allah, nor will their blood, but what reaches Him is piety from you.

symbols.ar: ذَٰلِكَ وَمَنْ يُعَظِّمْ شَعَائِرَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّهَا مِنْ تَقْوَى الْقُلُوبِ
symbols.en: That [is so]. And whoever honors the symbols of Allah, indeed, it is from the piety of hearts.

accept.ar: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
accept.en: Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing.

obligation.ar: وَلِلَّهِ عَلَى النَّاسِ حِجُّ الْبَيْتِ مَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ إِلَيْهِ سَبِيلًا
obligation.en: And [due] to Allah from the people is a pilgrimage to the House, for whoever is able to find thereto a way.

signs.ar: فِيهِ آيَاتٌ بَيِّنَاتٌ مَقَامُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ۖ وَمَنْ دَخَلَهُ كَانَ آمِنًا
signs.en: In it are clear signs [such as] the standing place of Abraham. And whoever enters it shall be safe.

return.ar: وَإِذْ جَعَلْنَا الْبَيْتَ مَثَابَةً لِلنَّاسِ وَأَمْنًا
return.en: And [mention] when We made the House a place of return for the people and [a place of] security.

maqam.en: And take, [O believers], from the standing place of Abraham a place of prayer.

niyyah.ar: إنَّما الأعْمالُ بالنِّيّاتِ، وإنَّما لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ ما نَوَى
niyyah.en: Actions are only by intentions, and every person shall have only what he intended.

mabrur.ar: العُمْرَةُ إلى العُمْرَةِ كَفَّارَةٌ لِما بيْنَهُمَا، والحَجُّ المَبْرُورُ ليسَ له جَزَاءٌ إلَّا الجَنَّةُ
mabrur.en: One Umrah to the next is an expiation for what lies between them, and an accepted Hajj has no reward but Paradise.

rafath.ar: مَن حَجَّ لِلَّهِ فَلَمْ يَرْفُثْ، ولَمْ يَفْسُقْ، رَجَعَ كَيَومِ ولَدَتْهُ أُمُّهُ
rafath.en: Whoever performs Hajj for Allah and avoids obscenity and wrongdoing returns as on the day his mother bore him.

arafah.ar: ما مِن يَومٍ أَكْثَرَ مِن أَنْ يُعْتِقَ اللَّهُ فيه عَبْدًا مِنَ النَّارِ، مِن يَومِ عَرَفَةَ، وإنَّه لَيَدْنُو، ثُمَّ يُبَاهِي بهِمُ المَلَائِكَةَ، فيَقولُ: ما أَرَادَ هَؤُلَاءِ؟
arafah.en: There is no day on which Allah frees more servants from the Fire than the Day of Arafah. He draws near, then speaks proudly of them to the angels, saying: What do these want?
